players.product: multi-beam and single-beam electron-beam mask writers and spot-beam electron-beam lithography systems (Industrial Equipment); TEM / FIB systems for semiconductor inspection

quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): net sales JPY 179,353 million (-8.8% from JPY 196,695 million), mainly on lower Industrial Equipment sales; operating profit JPY 26,017 million (-26.7% from JPY 35,501 million); ordinary profit JPY 28,610 million (-16.9%); profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 22,097 million (+18.2%). Segment net sales: Scientific / Metrology Instruments JPY 116,295 million (-6.8%), Industrial Equipment JPY 48,131 million (-14.8%), Medical Equipment JPY 14,926 million (-3.2%). Operating margin 14.5% (-3.5 points), ROE 15.7%, ROIC 12.3%. No external customer accounted for 10% or more of net sales.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 179,353 million (-8.8%); operating profit JPY 26,017 million (-26.7%); Industrial Equipment sales JPY 48,131 million (-14.8%)

quarterly_data.signal: Industrial Equipment, FY2026 (management's analysis): orders and sales of Single-Beam Mask Writers and Spot-Beam Electron Beam Lithography Systems held firm. Management expects demand for Spot-Beam systems to grow further for manufacturing processes, including mass-production ramps, as DFB lasers used in optical transceivers for AI data centers become higher-performance and more diverse. For Multi-Beam Mask Writers, the market shows signs of recovery, but the full recovery of capital investment at major customers is later than expected and the demand ramp is still taking time.

Production, orders and backlog, FY2026 (annual securities report): orders received JPY 180,069 million (96.6% of the prior year) and order backlog JPY 103,920 million (100.7%); Industrial Equipment orders JPY 45,523 million (91.7%) and backlog JPY 48,438 million (94.9%); Scientific / Metrology Instruments orders JPY 119,171 million (97.9%) and backlog JPY 53,058 million (105.7%). Production (at selling prices) JPY 174,616 million (89.7%), of which Industrial Equipment JPY 43,137 million (86.2%).
quarterly_data.figure: order backlog JPY 103,920 million (100.7% YoY); Industrial Equipment backlog JPY 48,438 million (94.9%)

quarterly_data.signal: Capex, FY2026: total capital investment JPY 20,182 million - Scientific / Metrology Instruments JPY 15,493 million (manufacturing jigs and R&D equipment), Industrial Equipment JPY 2,801 million (mainly to strengthen the production system), Medical Equipment JPY 335 million, corporate assets JPY 1,552 million. Major planned new facilities as of March 31, 2026: Akishima Works (Scientific / Metrology Instruments and Industrial Equipment) factory and building, JPY 25,000 million total (JPY 6,700 million already paid), started January 2026, completion planned December 2027; Akishima Works factory and building, JPY 2,500 million, and production / manufacturing and development / design equipment, JPY 7,000 million, both April 2026 to March 2027; Musashimurayama Works (Industrial Equipment) factory, building and production equipment, JPY 500 million, April 2026 to March 2027; JEOL Yamagata Tendo Plant (Scientific / Metrology Instruments) factory and building, JPY 9,000 million (JPY 5,600 million paid), May 2025 to March 2027. The company says the added capacity cannot reasonably be calculated (stated as slight for the smaller projects).
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 capex JPY 20,182 million; Akishima Works plan JPY 25,000 million (completion December 2027)

quarterly_data.signal: R&D, FY2026: total R&D expenses JPY 11,405 million, of which Scientific / Metrology Instruments JPY 7,632 million (electron microscopes, with focus on semiconductor and life-science products and solutions) and Industrial Equipment JPY 2,387 million. In Industrial Equipment the company is developing new models and improving the performance of its electron-beam lithography systems (Spot Beam and VSB types), develops and supplies components, matched to market needs, for the Multi Beam electron-beam lithography systems it brings to market in collaboration with IMS Nanofabrication, and continues work on additive manufacturing of high-melting-point metals for its electron-beam metal 3D printer.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D expenses JPY 11,405 million; Industrial Equipment JPY 2,387 million

quarterly_data.signal: Medium-term plan 'Evolving Growth 2.0 -A New Horizon-' (the company's fiscal 2025 to fiscal 2029, five years from April 2025, i.e. FY2026-FY2030 under the fiscal-year-end convention; 'YOKOGUSHI 2.0' strategy) sets semiconductors and life sciences as focus fields, and targets for its final year (the company's fiscal 2029, FY2030 here) an operating margin of 21.5%, ROE of 15% or more and ROIC of 15% or more; the long-term 'Vision 2035' aims for top-class share in focus markets such as semiconductors and life sciences.
quarterly_data.figure: final-year (FY2030) targets: operating margin 21.5%; ROE 15% or more; ROIC 15% or more

quarterly_data.signal: Material contract: on September 2, 2025 the company signed a share transfer agreement to spin its Medical Equipment business (biochemical automatic analyzers) into a newly formed wholly owned subsidiary by absorption-type split and transfer all of its shares to Sysmex; the transfer was completed on April 1, 2026.
